title: Drive the King Off the Edge
setup: Black's king is on f1 with a bishop on h1 behind it, and your queen sits far away on h8.
hint: The king is on the back rank, which sounds safe. Push it one file at a time and watch it stop being safe.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qf6+}} and {{Rg1+}} drive the king from f1 to d2, and {{Qb2#}} catches it in the middle. A king pushed off the edge is more exposed than one left on it.
